summary: Offered to the market with no onward chain, this well presented three bedroom mid terrace property provides an excellent opportunity for first time buyers, families, or investors alike.
description:
LIVING ROOM A bright and spacious living room offering a comfortable and versatile living space. Featuring a large window that allows plenty of natural light to flood the room.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of white wall and base units providing ample storage and worktop space. Complemented by a practical layout, there is a rear door providing accses to the yard.

BATHROOM Bathroom housed downstairs, consisting of panelled bath, wc and sink basin.

BEDROOM A well proportioned double bedroom offering ample space for freestanding furniture. The room benefits from a fitted cupboard providing useful storage.

BEDROOM A spacious second double bedroom, well presented and offering ample room for a double bed and additional bedroom furniture.

BEDROOM Third bedroom, single bedroom ideal for a home office or guest bedroom.
